govt_response.summary: The government published state-wise achievement data and continued the irrigation component into the 12th Plan.

analysis: Bharat Nirman set a four-year target of 10 million hectares of additional irrigation potential for 2005-06 to 2008-09. The Ministry of Water Resources reported 6.14 million hectares created by March 2009 and estimated about 7 million hectares by the end of the period. A separate compilation put the figure at 7.34 million hectares by September 2009, 73.4% of the target. The shortfall was about 2.7-3.9 million hectares at the 2009 checkpoint.
notes: The 2009 target is stated in the 2005-06 Budget speech ('by the year 2009'); the I-Day speech itself does not give a date. Some later government data use a 2005-2010 window. [ingest: 1 evidence link(s) blocked/unreachable to the checker; verify manually]
